mapper.update: UPDATE video SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{videoId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.select:
SELECT v.id, v.title, v.description, v.cover_url AS coverUrl, v.video_url AS videoUrl, v.duration, v.view_count AS viewCount, v.like_count AS likeCount, v.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, v.publish_time AS publishTime,
v.author_id AS authorId, u.username AS authorUsername, u.nickname AS authorNickname,
v.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName
FROM video v INNER JOIN sys_user u ON v.author_id = u.id INNER JOIN video_category c ON v.category_id = c.id
WHERE v.id = #{videoId} AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video ( author_id, category_id, title, description, cover_url, video_url, duration, status, view_count, like_count, favorite_count ) VALUES ( #{authorId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{videoUrl}, #{duration}, #{status}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{favoriteCount} )
mapper.select:
SELECT v.id, v.title, v.description, v.cover_url AS coverUrl, v.video_url AS videoUrl, v.duration, v.status, v.reject_reason AS rejectReason, v.create_time AS createTime, v.cover_url AS coverObjectName, v.video_url AS videoObjectName,
u.id AS authorId, u.username AS authorUsername, u.nickname AS authorNickname,
c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName
FROM video v LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON v.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN video_category c ON v.category_id = c.id
WHERE v.status = 'PENDING'
ORDER BY v.create_time ASC
mapper.update:
UPDATE video SET status = #{status},
reject_reason = #{rejectReason},
publish_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{videoId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select:
SELECT v.id, v.title, v.description, v.cover_url AS coverUrl, v.video_url AS videoUrl, v.cover_url AS coverObjectName, v.video_url AS videoObjectName, v.duration, v.status, v.reject_reason AS rejectReason, v.publish_time AS publishTime, v.create_time AS createTime, v.view_count AS viewCount, v.like_count AS likeCount, v.favorite_count AS favoriteCount,
v.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName
FROM video v LEFT JOIN video_category c ON v.category_id = c.id
WHERE v.author_id = #{authorId}
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE video SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, video_url = #{videoUrl}, duration = #{duration}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
